features.description: Assistant runs expose a durable run/session/turn contract with terminal envelope fields and a context compiler snapshot comparable to Hermes' operational clarity and OpenClaw's capability truthfulness.
steps: Define additive run/session/turn fields for Assistant runtime and stream/non-stream parity.
Record exit_reason, interrupted, approval_pending, tool_error, max_iterations, checkpoint_id, trace_id, model/provider snapshot, and redaction state.
Define a context_snapshot_id or hash that records runtime facts used to compile model context.
Record bootstrap/context inputs with raw bytes, injected bytes, missing markers, truncation reasons, and context tier.
Ensure prompt-exposed tools, memory snippets, workspace scope, sandbox state, and surface capabilities match actual runtime policy.
Add tests for stop/cancel, approval pending, tool error, max iteration, resume plan, and terminal stream events.
acceptance_gates: Existing API compatibility is preserved.
Turn envelope fields are available to trace/eval and future UI surfaces.
Tests fail when prompt-exposed capabilities drift from actual registry/tool/sandbox state.
Tests prove stream and non-stream paths agree on terminal state.

AgentLoop streaming-first now exposes contract fields on run_started, context_budget, streaming_first_completed, run_finished/run_error, approval_required, cancellation, and trace metadata. Non-stream AssistantService.chat returns the same fields and non-agent-loop SSE done forwards them. No DB schema, migration, deployment, UI, Hermes import, or OpenClaw import was added.

features.description: Assistant memory adopts Hermes-style lifecycle discipline and OpenClaw-style memory layer separation while preserving AI--Platfform's multi-tenant DB-backed memory model.
steps: Harden memory source writes with transactional or atomic semantics, dedup, drift checks, and bounded threat scanning.
Separate stable user profile facts from daily/reflection/project memory sources.
Define workspace memory source enumeration rules for MEMORY.md, memory.md, memory/**/*.md, optional extra paths, symlink skipping, and realpath de-duplication where applicable to AI--Platfform.
Separate session transcript, durable memory, checkpoint summary, trace, and retrieval index responsibilities.
Define memory provider lifecycle hooks for prefetch, completed-turn sync, session end/switch, pre-compact, write, and flush.
Define pre-compaction memory flush behavior, one-per-cycle guard, failure handling, skip reasons, and evidence shape.
Record compaction parent/child lineage and provenance for resume.
acceptance_gates: Interrupted, cancelled, failed, or approval-pending turns do not sync to long-term memory by default.
Injected memory snippets include source id/path, source type, score, recency, and untrusted-context marker.
Session transcript is replay state and does not silently become long-term durable memory.
Tests cover concurrent writes, duplicate facts, provider failure, workspace source enumeration, transcript/durable memory separation, pre-compaction flush, and compaction resume lineage.

features.notes: Implemented additive assistant-memory-lifecycle/v1 helpers, bounded/deduped source-store write metadata, per-path process locks, profile memory in USER.md, workspace memory source enumeration, completed-turn-only durable sync through AHR-01 terminal_envelope, runtime memory provenance, pre-compaction flush evidence, and compaction parent/child lineage. No DB schema, migration, deployment, UI, Hermes import, or OpenClaw import was added.

features.description: Medium/high-risk and confirmation-required tools fail closed unless routed through ExecutionGateway or an equivalent audited approval gateway, and skills/plugins/connectors/tools have separate governance boundaries.
steps: Prevent direct registry execution of risky tools outside explicit test-only bypasses.
Require tool risk, permission, sandbox profile, audit shape, and redaction policy metadata.
Separate skill-like knowledge packages from executable plugin, connector, MCP, and internal tool capability.
Require plugin/connector/tool trust level, owner, prompt-exposure text, and approval class metadata.
Require prompt mutation hooks to be opt-in, allowlisted, source-tagged, ordered, bounded, and blocked with visible reason when disallowed.
Canonicalize approval plans and bind them to tenant, user, run, session, tool, normalized args hash, resource scope, env preview hash, and mutable operands when present.
Fail duplicate or shadowed tool registration by default outside trusted override flow.
Sanitize MCP and external tool catalog text, including parameter descriptions.
Redact or hash audit input summaries and checkpoint tool args.
acceptance_gates: Approval is bound to tenant/user/run/tool/arguments_hash and single-use.
Denied, timed-out, missing, or DB-unavailable approval stops the risky action.
Code execution fails closed when Docker/gVisor/sandbox is unavailable.
Execution decisions expose effective policy, policy source, sandbox profile, approval/elevation state, and denial reason.
Prompt-exposure text from plugins, MCP, catalogs, webhooks, or external docs is bounded, sanitized, and marked untrusted unless code-owned.
No raw secrets or full raw tool arguments are written to trace, logs, audit, checkpoint, export, or gate reports.
features.evidence: AHR-03 passed: deploy/runbooks/assistant-hermes-runtime-prd/reports/ahr-03-tool-permission-and-runtime-safety-report.md; critic approved: deploy/runbooks/assistant-hermes-runtime-prd/reports/ahr-03-tool-permission-and-runtime-safety-critic.md; validation passed with `uv run --package assistant-service pytest -q --no-cov tests/services/assistant` (1058 passed), eval golden gate (4 passed), changed-file ruff check, and git diff --check.
features.notes: Implemented fail-closed direct registry execution for medium/high-risk and confirmation-required tools, duplicate registration failure by default with explicit trusted override, gateway-approved execution metadata, approval DB-failure denial, recursive audit summary redaction, MCP catalog/parameter sanitization, and configured sandbox runtime enforcement for code execution. No DB schema, migration, deployment, UI, Hermes import, or OpenClaw import was added.

features.description: The Eval Console becomes a runtime quality cockpit that connects trace, trajectory, safety, review, golden, and gate workflows.
steps: Extend trace capture and metrics for run, model, tool, approval, memory retrieval, checkpoint/resume, errors, and trace write failures.
Add trace and eval fields for context snapshot, memory index freshness, retrieval source breakdown, session transcript search state, and pre-compaction flush success/failure.
Add runtime-focused golden cases for approval denial, argument mismatch, sandbox unavailable, interrupted memory skip, stop/resume, and redaction/export.
Add trajectory scoring inputs for context/tool/memory sequence quality, not only final answer quality.
Expose overview and detail UI states in /eval without leaking secrets.
Allow failed traces to enter review, golden, or failure-case workflows.
acceptance_gates: Assistant is fully enabled; RAG/LangGraph remain wired or partial with accurate state.
Export and gate reports remain bounded and redacted.
Frontend type-check and lint pass after UI changes.
Golden regression includes runtime safety, memory-observability, context capability, and trajectory cases.
